rows.note: Use this for a dark figure or object seen against a brighter background.

example.english: At dusk, we saw a silhouette on the distant hillside.
example.traditional: 黃昏時，我哋見到遠處山坡上有個黑影。
example.jyutping: wong4 fan1 si4 ngo5 dei6 gin3 dou2 jyun5 cyu3 saan1 bo1 soeng6 jau5 go3 hak1 jing2

rows.note: Use this for an intentionally made artistic silhouette, especially a cut-paper or solid-colour profile.

example.english: She cut a silhouette of Grandma out of black paper and framed it.
example.traditional: 佢將張黑紙剪成外婆嘅剪影，仲裱咗起嚟。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoeng1 zoeng1 hak1 zi2 zin2 sing4 ngoi6 po4 ge3 zin2 jing2 zung6 biu2 zo2 hei2 lei4

rows.note: Use this in fashion for the overall outline or shape of a garment on the wearer.

example.english: The silhouette of this dress is very flattering when worn.
example.traditional: 呢條裙嘅輪廓好修身，著上身好靚。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 kwan4 ge3 leon4 kwok3 hou2 sau1 san1 zoek3 soeng5 san1 hou2 leng3
